Basic.name: Grapple
Basic.description:
Make a Brawling check versus an creature's within reach Brawling roll. 
It may defend with a Reflex or Fortitude save instead, taking a -2 penalty to the roll
On a success, you Grapple the creature. 
On a critical success, the creature becomes Restrained instead
While you have the creature grabbed, it is immobilized and off-guard 3
You can only have one creature grabbed at a time and you cannot grab a creature two or more sizes larger than you.
Successfully grappling an already grappled creature Restrains them

Basic.name: Reactive Strike
Basic.description:
You take advantage of a creature moving within your reach.
Make an attack against the creature with -3 penalty, or -2 if you have agile weapon
Basic.prerequisites: A creature takes a traverse action within the reach of your weapon.

Basic.name: Shove
Basic.description:
Make a Brawling check versus an creature's within reach Brawling roll. 
It may defend with a Reflex or Fortitude save instead, taking a -2 penalty to the roll
On a success, you push the creature up to 2 tiles away from you. 
On a critical success, the creature is shoved up to 4 tiles instead
You cannot shove a creature two or more sizes larger than you.
Basic.prerequisites: You have one hand free or a weapon with Shove trait

Basic.name: Trip
Basic.description:
Make a Brawling check versus an creature's within reach Brawling roll. 
It may defend with a Reflex or Fortitude save instead, taking a -2 penalty to the roll 
On a success, the creature falls prone.
On a critical success, the creature also takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage. 
You cannot trip a creature two or more sizes larger than you.

Simple.name: Aim
Simple.description:
You carefully aim your next ranged attack, gaining a +2 bonus to the attack roll. 
Additionally you ignore the obscured roll on the attack if the target is obscured
The bonus lasts until you move or the start of your next turn.
Simple.prerequisites: You are holding a ranged weapon

Simple.name: Block Spell
Simple.description:
You position your shield in front of the blast. Make your save with a -4 penalty.
If you succeed the allies you a providing cover don't have to make the save
Simple.prerequisites: A creature is targeting you and at least one ally, who you providing cover to and you have a shield raised

Simple.name: Charge
Simple.description:
You rush forward, attacking your opponent with your momentum.
Stride twice, then make a melee strike.

Simple.name: Combat Assessment
Simple.description:
As you strike an enemy you quickly assess its capabilities. 
Make a Recall Knowledge check against the creature.
Simple.prerequisites: You hit an enemy with a melee strike

Simple.name: Cut Down Projectile
Simple.description:
Attempt to cut down the projectile. 
Make a melee attack against it, instead of a Reflex saving throw
Simple.prerequisites: You are currently parrying and you would make a Reflex saving throw against a projectile

Simple.name: Defensive Positions
Simple.description:
Your order your allies to take cover.
Up to three allies can use their reactions to Step, Stride or Traverse into Cover or use the Block, Parry or Take Cover actions

Simple.name: Double Slice
Simple.description:
Make two weapon attacks at the same target, one with each weapon. 
If the second weapon is agile it takes no multiple attack penalty, otherwise the penalty is -2.
If both attacks hit you combine their damage for the purpose of overcoming resistances.
Simple.prerequisites: You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.

Simple.name: Duck
Simple.description:
You attempt to dive out of the effect. You move 1 tile. 
If this causes you to leave the area of the spell you have +5 bonus to the saving throw, otherwise it's a +3 bonus. 
After making the save you fall prone.
Simple.prerequisites: You are forced to make a Reflex saving throw and have a move speed

Simple.name: Far Shot
Simple.description:
You make a shot beyond the normal range of the weapon
Make a ranged strike at two range increments above the default at no penalty.

Simple.name: Feint
Simple.description:
You make a maneuver that appears as strike to throw an enemy off-guard. 
Make a Deception check against an enemies Perception roll.
On a success, the creature becomes off-guard 2 for the rest of the turn
On a critical success,  the creature becomes off-guard 2 until the start of its next turn
Simple.prerequisites: You have an enemy in reach of one your melee strikes

Simple.name: Flying Kick
Simple.description:
Leap then make an unarmed Strike at any point during the leap.
It deals an additional d4 damage

Simple.name: Lunge
Simple.description:
Attack an enemy at the edge of your reach. 
Make a melee strike with a 1 tile bonus range

Simple.name: Measured Strike
Simple.description:
You strike with measured practice.
Make a strike with half your current multiple attack penalty (rounded down)

Simple.name: Movementum Roll
Simple.description:
You use the momentum of the effect that would knock you down to roll forward and kip up.
Make an Acrobatics against the effect that would knock you prone.
On a success you Step once and don't fall prone.
On a critical success you also gain a +2 bonus to all saves until the start of your turn

Simple.name: Pommel Strike
Simple.description:
Make an attack with the backend of your weapon using the momentum of your last strike.
Make a strike with the same MAP as your last attack
On a hit it does 1d4 bludgeoning damage or 1d6 if you hold the weapon in both hands
If your weapon has the unwieldy trait, this strike ignores that
Simple.prerequisites: You are wielding a weapon in the Polearm or Spear group and you last action was to make a Strike with it

Simple.name: Protect Ally
Simple.description:
Instead of defending yourself you ready to protect your ally.
Give an adjacent creature a defense bonus equal to the Block value of your shield. 
You cannot Block and Protect Ally at the same time with the same weapon.
Simple.prerequisites: You are holding a weapon with the Block trait

Simple.name: Quick Draw
Simple.description:
You draw a weapon and strike with in the same movement. 
Draw a weapon and Strike with it.

Simple.name: Rapid Retreat
Simple.description:
You order an ally to flee from danger.
Chose an ally and enemy. The ally can use their reactions to Stride or Traverse to move away from that enemy.
They move with a +1 move speed bonus and the chosen enemy has disadvantage on Reactive Strikes from the movement

Simple.name: Riposte
Simple.description:
Take advantage of the opening to attack your opponent. 
Make a Strike at that creature
Simple.prerequisites: You are currently parrying and a creature missed you with a melee strike

Simple.name: Running Reload
Simple.description:
You move and reload your weapon simultaneously. 
Stride with a -2 speed penalty and Reload your weapon
You can spend a focus point to stride at full speed

Simple.name: Set Weapon
Simple.description:
Set your weapon ready to strike a foes that come into your reach.
If you make a Reactive Strike until the start of the next turn you ignore the penalty on the strike.
On a critical hit you deal an additional d6 damage.

Simple.name: Slide Into Cover
Simple.description:
With a swift move you move and take cover at once.
Stride or Step then Take Cover

Simple.name: Snap Shot
Simple.description:
Make a quick shot in the heart of battle. 
Make a Strike, ignoring the Volley trait
Simple.prerequisites: You a wielding a weapon with the Volley Trait

Simple.name: Strike Now!
Simple.description:
You order an ally to strike at an opportune moment.
Choose an ally, they can use a reaction to make an attack at a target you both can see.

Simple.name: Sweep
Simple.description:
Make a strike against two adjacent enemies in range of your melee weapon. 
They make their own Reflex saving throw against the attack.
This counts as two attacks for your MAP
Simple.prerequisites: You are wielding a melee weapon with Sweep trait

Simple.name: Tumble Through
Simple.description:
You slide through an opponent.
Make a Acrobatics check against a creature's Reflex save
On a success you move through their space without provoking reactive strikes.
On a critical success they also become of guard to you until the start of your turn.
Simple.prerequisites: You are adjacent to the creature and your move speed is higher than the tiles it occupies

Simple.name: Wild Strike
Simple.description:
Strike in a wild swing that leaves you open afterward. 
Make a melee Strike and add your PHY again to the damage
After that making this Strike you become off-guard 2 until the start of your next turn, or prone if you were already off-guard.

Advanced.name: Blade Dance
Advanced.description:
You move graceful like a dancer in the flow of combat
Strike, then Step, then Strike another creature
Advanced.prerequisites: You are wielding a weapon that does slashing or piercing damage

Advanced.name: Double Shot
Advanced.description:
You draw two arrows at once and loose them at separate targets.
Make two attacks on two different targets in range with a weapon in bow group. 
You have a -2 penalty on both attacks, but your multiple attack penalty increases first after both shots
You can spend a focus point to use this as one action

Advanced.name: Flurry of Blows
Advanced.description:
Make 3 unarmed strikes. 
Each strike counts towards your MAP, but it increases first after all three
Advanced.prerequisites: You have at least one hand free

Advanced.name: Momentum Toss
Advanced.description:
Make a Brawling check against the creature's Brawling roll. 
It may defend with a Reflex or Fortitude save instead, taking a -2 penalty to the roll
If they got a critical failure on their attack they have a -5 penalty the roll
On a success, you move the creature to another free square adjacent to you.
On a critical success, the creature also falls prone.
Advanced.prerequisites: An creature within your unarmed reach attacks misses an attack against you and you have a hand free

Advanced.name: Piercing Thrust
Advanced.description:
You strike through a creature to hit both it and a creature behind.
Make Strike against two creatures in a line within reach of your weapon.
This counts as two attacks for your MAP
Advanced.prerequisites: You are wielding a weapon that does piercing damage

Advanced.name: Pincer Movement
Advanced.description:
You know how to outmaneuver your enemies
Choose two allies, they can use their reactions to Step, Stride or Traverse next to an enemy. 
If they end their movements on the opposite sides of an enemy, one of them can make a Strike against that enemy

Advanced.name: Guarded Advance
Advanced.description:
Move protected towards your opponent.
Block or Parry, then Stride twice. 
You must end your movement closer to an enemy than you started

Advanced.name: Pinning Shot
Advanced.description:
You shoot or throw your weapon in way that pins an enemy to the ground or wall.
Make a Strike against a creature. 
On a hit the creature takes no damage, but is immobilized and off guard until they spend an action to make a DC 10 Athletics or Acrobatics check.
On a critical hit the DC is 15
Advanced.prerequisites: You are holding a weapon in the Bow, Crossbow or Spear weapon groups

Advanced.name: Predict Their Movement
Advanced.description:
Attempt to predict a foes next move.
Make a Tactics Lore roll against the Tactics Lore or Deception of a creature you can see within 10 tiles.
On a success you learn the next action the creature is planning to next turn.
It can either choose to do that or take -2 penalty to all actions next turn as scrambles to adapt.

Advanced.name: Quick Parry
Advanced.description:
You draw your weapon in the blink of an eye and parry an opponent's strike.
You may draw a weapon with the Parry trait from a quick access slot.
Then defend against the attack as if you had parried the turn before
Advanced.prerequisites: You are forced to make a Reflex saving throw against a melee strike

Advanced.name: Spellbreak Strike
Advanced.description:
You know how to make a strike to disrupt a sustained spell
Make a unarmed melee strike or one with a weapon with the channeling trait
On a hit, make a INT or WIL check against the targets Fortitude Save, breaking the sustained spell on a success.
If you know the spell you may add your proficiency with it to the strike.

Advanced.name: Stunning Strike
Advanced.description:
Make a forceful strike against an enemy. 
On a hit they need to make a Fortitude Saving throw or be Stunned 1, or Stunned 2 on a Critical Failure
Advanced.prerequisites: You are wielding a weapon that does bludgeoning damage

Complex.name: Cut Down Spell
Complex.description:
You've learned to cut down spells just like projectiles. 
Make a melee attack against it, instead of a Reflex saving throw
Complex.prerequisites: You are currently parrying and you would make a Reflex saving throw against a targeting spell

Complex.name: Deadshot
Complex.description:
You take a moment to focus and take a perfectly aimed shot.
Make a ranged strike, it does an additional weapon dice of damage

Complex.name: Run and Gun
Complex.description: Stride then Stride or Take Cover, then make an attack with a ranged weapon

Masterwork.name: A Thousand Cuts
Masterwork.description:
You move faster than what should be possible, cutting into an enemy.
Make a melee attack with an agile weapon.
If you hit you may attack again at a -2 penalty, or -1 if you attack with a weapon in your other hand
You may keep attacking until you miss, with the multi attack penalty increasing as described above every time

Masterwork.name: Crash of the Titan
Masterwork.description:
Your weapon slams into the ground, creating a shockwave from the impact
Strike a tile within range, all creatures on and adjacent from it need to make Reflex saves against the attack.
Creatures on the slammed tile take an additional 2d10 bludgeoning damage. 
This bonus is doubled if you were falling or jumping as you did the attack

Masterwork.name: Moonlight Crescent
Masterwork.description:
You make a strike that seems to extend your weapon beyond its normal reach, cutting into multiple foes
Make a strike against up to five adjacent enemies in range of your melee weapon with a 1 tile bonus range
They make their own Reflex saving throw against the attack.
On a hit they take an extra 2d8 damage from the strike

Masterwork.name: Serpent Stride
Masterwork.description: Step, Stride, Strike and Parry in any order
